purpose: Modern formal MSVC build evidence and portable test executables, not a product installer or runtime certification.
test_working_directories: Package paths in executables.json; choose an isolated controlled root.
limitations: Static CRT does not prove OS API compatibility.
Already terminated/cancelled hosted jobs may prevent always-upload.
Doctests are not compiled into the collected no-run harness executables.
Actual Windows 7/10/11 and classroom-device runs require separate evidence.
